transliteration: wa ta'annayta wa anta maly'un bilmubadara
english_text: and acted without haste, while Thou art full of quick accomplishment!

arabic_text: لَمْ تَكُنْ أَنَاتُكَ عَجْزاً، وَلا إمْهَالُكَ وَهْناً، وَلاَ إمْسَاكُكَ غَفْلَةً، وَلاَ انْتِظَارُكَ مُدَارَاةً،
transliteration: lam takun 'anatuka 'ajzan, wa-la 'imhaluka wahnan walā imsākuka ghaflah, walā intiẓāruka mudārāh
english_text: Not because of incapacity is Thy slowness, feebleness Thy giving respite, heedlessness Thy showing restraint, dissemblance Thy waiting!

arabic_text: بَلْ لِتَكُونَ حُجَّتُكَ أَبْلَغَ، وَكَرَمُكَ أكمَلَ، وَإحْسَانُكَ أَوْفَى وَنِعْمَتُكَ أَتَمَّ،
transliteration: bal litakūna ḥujjatuka ablagh, wa karamuka akmal wa-iḥsānuka awfā wa-niʿmatuka atamma
english_text: But that Thy argument be more conclusive, Thy generosity more perfect, Thy beneficence more exhaustive, Thy favour more complete!

arabic_text: كُلُّ ذلِكَ كَانَ وَلَمْ تَزَلْ، وَهُوَ كائِنٌ وَلاَ تَزَالُ ،
transliteration: kullu dhālika kāna wa lam tazal, wa huwa kā'inun wa lā tazālu
english_text: All of this has been and always was, is and ever will be.

arabic_text: حُجَّتُكَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ توصَفَ بِكُلِّهَا، وَمَجْدُكَ أَرْفَـعُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحَدَّ بِكُنْهِهِ، وَنِعْمَتُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُحْصَى بِأَسْرِهَا، وَإحْسَانُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُشْكَرَ عَلَى أَقَلِّهِ،
transliteration: ḥujjatuka ʾajallu min an tūṣafa bikullihā wa majduka arfa'u min an yuhadda bikunhihi wa niʿmatuka aktharu min an tuḥṣā bi-asrihā wa-iḥsānuka aktharu min an tushkara ʿalā aqallih
english_text: Thy argument is greater than that its totality be described, Thy glory more elevated than that it be limited in its core, Thy favour more abundant than that its entirety be counted, Thy beneficence more abundant than that thanks be given for its least amount!

arabic_text: وَقَدْ قَصَّرَ بِيَ السُّكُوتُ عَنْ تَحْمِيدِكَ، وَفَهَّهَنِي الإمْسَاكُ عَنْ تَمْجيدِكَ، وَقُصَارَايَ الإقْرَارُ بِالْحُسُورِ لاَ رَغْبَةً ـ يا إلهِي ـ بَلْ عَجْزاً،
transliteration: waqad qassara biya al-sukutu ʿan tahmidiكَ، wa fahhahani al-im'sāku ʿan tamjīdik wa quṣārāy al-iqrār bi al-ḥusoor lā raghbaṭan, yā ilāhī, bal ʿajzan
english_text: Speechlessness has made me fall short of praising Thee, restraint has made me powerless to glorify Thee, and the most I can do is admit to inability, not out of desire, my God, but out of incapacity.

arabic_text: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا أَؤُمُّكَ بِالْوِفَادَةِ، وَأَسأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الرِّفَادَةِ، فَصلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاسْمَعْ نَجْوَايَ، وَاسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِي وَلاَ تَخْتِمْ يَوْمِيَ بِخَيْبَتِي، وَلاَ تَجْبَهْنِي بِالرَّدِّ فِي مَسْأَلَتِي،
transliteration: fahā anā dhā aʾummuka bil-wifādah, wa as'aluka ḥusn ar-riifādah faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-smaʿ najwaya wa-istajib du'ā'ī wa-lā takhtim yawmiya bi-khaybati wa lā tajbah-nī bir-raddi fī mas'alatī
english_text: So here I am: I repair to Thee by coming forward, and I ask from Thee good support So bless Muhammad and his Household, hear my whispered words, grant my supplication, seal not my day with disappointment, slap not my brow by rejecting my request,

arabic_text: وَأكْرِمْ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مُنْصَرَفِي وَإلَيْكَ مُنْقَلَبِي،
transliteration: waakrim min ʿindika munṣarafī waʾilayka munqalabī
english_text: and make noble my coming from Thee and my going back to Thee!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ غَيْرُ ضَائِق بِمَا تُرِيْدُ وَلاَ عَاجِزٍ عَمَّا تُسْأَلُ،
transliteration: 'innaka ghayru ḍā'iq bimā turīdu walā ʿājiz 'ammā tusalu
english_text: Surely Thou art not constrained by what Thou desirest, nor incapable of what Thou art asked!

arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيْرٌ، وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إلاَّ بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
transliteration: wa-anta ʿala kulli shay'in qadīrun wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāhi al-ʿaliyyi al-ʿaẓīm
english_text: Thou art powerful over everything, and there is no force and no strength save in God, the All-high, the All-mighty!
